title: About Cloud Ceramic Plinth Rupture
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 76 recent saved-signal files and 62 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @digitlartifacts: gorgeous ceramics from artist hedy yang and @om_patel5: SOMEONE TURNED THEIR TEAM'S TASK TRACKER INTO A 3D ISLAND instead of a boring list..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Cloud Ceramic Plinth Rupture: Bright product-photo rupture: a square frontal still life on a warm white plinth, side-lit object slab grammar, three cloud-painted satin ceramic vessels in triangular overlap with deep teal storm form closest. Keep a large pale upper field, clean horizontal plinth edge, pastel blue/peach/lavender weather gradients,... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against front teal ceramic belly, gold lightning inlay fracture, and front vase rim glint and small glaze chip.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
